children: The first Korean won-backed stablecoin, KRW1, issued by BDACS goes live onchain on Avalanche. Rain adds support for the asset, enabling won-denominated stablecoin card programs on its existing card infrastructure.

The launch gives Avalanche a new onchain supply of Korean won-denominated value. Through Rain, KRW1 holders can access card programs that accept Visa, connecting the stablecoin to everyday spending rather than trading alone. This creates an additional activity channel for the Avalanche network tied to a national currency. Realized impact depends on issuance scale, which BDACS has not yet stated, so the practical size of this KRW supply remains to be seen.
The Korean won is now onchain.
Rain is adding support for KRW1: the first won-backed stablecoin, issued by BDACS on Avalanche.
The partnership will make KRW1 spendable anywhere Visa is accepted.
Creating a new way for the won to reach the world.

title: Avalanche: KRW1 Won Stablecoin Goes Live with Rain Card Support - 15 Sep 2026
